sources.scope: Codex custom-agent pin precedence and recommended starting efforts
Codex model availability and Max/Ultra distinction

capability_evidence: Official Codex pages plus the active Codex host and collaboration tool schemas; revalidate on the target host before use. API parameter ranges are separate.

main-deep.rationale: Lead for goals with unresolved, interacting design decisions.

alaa-spec-analyst.rationale: Extract acceptance criteria and material ambiguity.

alaa-explorer.rationale: Bounded read-only discovery with source evidence.

alaa-researcher.rationale: Resolve source disagreement and version-specific evidence.

alaa-test-strategist.rationale: Design discriminating tests and agent evaluations.

alaa-implementer.rationale: Implement multi-step changes within a ratified design.

alaa-implementer-sol.rationale: Implement difficult changes requiring design judgment; retain legacy role identifier.

alaa-verifier.rationale: Execute exact checks and report evidence without debugging.

alaa-failure-analyst.rationale: Diagnose failure from incomplete and interacting evidence.

alaa-reviewer-deep.rationale: Same review contract for complex cross-subsystem interactions.

alaa-documenter.rationale: Document verified behavior without deciding product policy.

alaa-architecture-critic.rationale: Pressure-test boundaries, consistency, and design consequences.

alaa-security-reviewer.rationale: Judge trust boundaries and security failure paths.

alaa-migration-guardian.rationale: Analyze rollout ordering, compatibility, and recovery.

alaa-api-contract-reviewer.rationale: Trace consumer compatibility and transition windows.

alaa-dependency-auditor.rationale: Assess dependency evidence against explicit criteria.

alaa-accessibility-reviewer.rationale: Compare source and rendered evidence to accessibility criteria.

alaa-browser-qa.rationale: Navigate browser state and distinguish product from environment failure.

alaa-performance-profiler.rationale: Interpret measurements and separate bottlenecks from noise.

alaa-observability-reviewer.rationale: Assess diagnosability of declared failure modes.

alaa-release-guardian.rationale: Review packaging, configuration, and rollout evidence.

alaa-rule-writer.rationale: Compress drafted instructions without changing behavior.

alaa-instruction-reviewer.rationale: Independently review behavioral contracts governing other agents.
